scheme_name: One Time Cash Incentive towards Completing ITI, Typewriting, Accountancy, Bookkeeping, Tailoring, Computer Training (Sainik Welfare)
other_conditions: Applicant must be an Ex‑serviceman or Widow of the Ex‑serviceman or Dependent of the Widow of the Ex‑serviceman
Applicant must be registered with the Department of Sainik Welfare, Puducherry
If the applicant is the Ex‑serviceman, he/she must have become unemployed within three years of discharge from service
Applicant must obtain prior permission from the Department of Sainik Welfare, Puducherry
Course/program must be one of: ITI, Typewriting, Accountancy, Bookkeeping, Tailoring, Computer Training
Course/program must be undertaken at a Government‑recognized school/institution
Application must be submitted offline within three months from the date of successful completion of the course
benefits_summary: Up to ₹10,000 or the actual cost of the approved course is credited to the beneficiary’s bank account.
documents_required: Prescribed application form (printable from the official website)
Self‑attested copies of all mandatory documents
